## What's New in 1.4
- **Pinning works as expected:** pinned items stay at the top of the HUD under their own section, and every row has a pin button. - **Paste as plain text:** press ⇧↵ (or use the right-click menu) to paste without fonts or colours. - **Smoother scrolling:** image rows use small thumbnails instead of full-size screenshots. - **No more hitches when saving:** history is written in the background. - **Automatic updates:** Clipplic now checks for new versions once a day. Use "Check for Updates…" in the menu bar menu any time.
